capabilities: Merge and rename tags, including whole tag branches
Rename or merge property keys with conflict strategies
Bulk-add properties to notes in a folder
Normalize date values to one format
disambiguation: Not only about properties: it also merges, migrates and converts tags.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.8.7 or later), no mobile support. Works fully offline with no accounts or network requests; undo history is stored locally in the plugin folder. Free, with optional donations.
intentEvidence: The built-in property panel only renames one field in one note at a time
motivation: Vaults fill up with near-duplicate tags, inconsistent key names and dates written several ways, and deeper cleanup otherwise requires scripting.
problem: The built-in property panel only renames one field in one note at a time, so cleaning up near-duplicate tags, keys and dates means scripting or a linter plugin.
summary: Visual workbench that merges tags, renames or merges property keys, bulk-adds fields and normalizes dates across a chosen set of notes.
